scope: Framing-only benchmark on an owner-provided 1-vCPU Linux host; discard connection, no TLS or network throughput measurement
methodology: Both test executables include identical benchmark/test sources. Baseline overlays only ws_stream.go from the initial header-only PR #71 commit. Run before/after/after/before in independent Linux processes.
limitations: Measures server-side framing of one v2 UPD, not total smux allocations, TLS, socket throughput or tunnel latency.
The fixed 16-byte storage is added once per physical WebSocket carrier; each update avoids the 48-byte writer allocation.
A 16-byte metadata copy is used for UPD frames. Application payload vectors retain their existing path.
Masked client-side messages retain the normal Gorilla writer; the allocation reduction is server-side.
The remaining pool allocation is retained; this is not allocation-free framing.
No race-enabled native run was performed in the Windows cross-compilation environment.
native_tests: Five repetitions of ^Test(WSMux|WebSocketStream|ConcurrentMux|MuxSession) passed, including WS/WSS v2 echo through a 16 KiB stream window and 1 MiB session bucket. Temporary files were removed.

diagnostic_fixture.scope: The smaller session bucket timed out on both revisions. The per-stream-window test uses a larger session bucket to avoid mixing that pre-existing session-budget issue into UPD framing validation. This PR does not claim to fix the smaller-bucket issue.
